name: Cinder Vault
description: Deep beneath the ashfields, two sealed vaults hum with residual heat — and whatever was locked inside them.

setup.label: Vault Doors
setup.description: Place 2 Objective Markers 6" from the center, one on each side of the centerline.

results.text: Gain 1 VP for opening Vault A.
Gain 1 VP for opening Vault B.

questRules.description: Both vaults unlock simultaneously at the start of Round 2.
